title: Fixed Horizontal Chuck and Cross Slide Table Slot Mortiser
description: One newly authored complete fixed horizontal slot-mortiser-inspired exterior. A squat full pedestal cabinet and broad ground sole support a low rear horizontal motor housing, two complete saddles, a forward stepped chuck exterior and short blunt tool blank. In front, two complete perpendicular low guide and carriage stages carry a broad empty rectangular worktable, rather than a high column-mounted vertical spindle or a long ram. A whole raised side hold-down frame, separate vertical screw appearance, full round pad and transverse stopped handle stand on the table. Two whole projecting feed-control levers and a lower open-spoke height-control wheel belong to the fixed assembly. Full rear motor cap and bands and a plain inset-looking front cabinet panel complete the whole body. All numeric geometry newly authored, no old knee mill, notcher, drill or shaper part imported. Unlike the knee mill the spindle lies low and horizontal behind the table and there is no tall column or overhead ram; unlike the tube-notcher fixture the whole pedestal, rear motor and orthogonal broad sliding table replace the two swivel seats and V-jaw arrangement; unlike the shaper no high solid reciprocating ram or hanging clapper head exists. One complete model zero scenes, four opaque untextured constant PBR roles, metres Z up. No workpiece, sharp cutter, feed travel, slide fit, actual clamp action, spindle rotation, machining result, motor circuit, power, accuracy, ergonomic fit, manufacture, stability rating or safe operation is made or verified.
